statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail is 7 with NQ observed at 29,518.75 inside a 72-point two-sided overnight range and no gap from the 29,538.75 settle, while stress stays at 73 on WTI at three-month highs near $94.7, Brent near $99.5 and roughly 60% market-implied odds of a 16 September Fed hike.
recommendation: Tail remains far below the block threshold, so the mapped state is EA_ON for both NQ futures and the NAS100 CFD. The narrow evidence-based danger window covers the 13:30-14:30 UTC U.S. cash open, where opening-auction continuation with shallow pullbacks would be the first genuine tail amplifier of the session. Existing-position management, exits and emergency protection remain active throughout.
headline: NQ holds a 72-point two-sided overnight range at 29,518.75 with tail at 7, while three-month-high crude and roughly 60% implied odds of a Fed hike keep stress at 73
body: Observed evidence at the assessment cutoff shows an orderly overnight path. NQ futures trade 29,518.75, down 20.00 points or 0.07%, inside a 29,489.75-29,561.75 Globex range of just 72 points, two-sided and with no gap from the 29,538.75 prior settle; a second primary quote confirms the level at 29,523.50. Cash NDX closed 29,507.70, down 0.12%, in the upper half of a 29,400.70-29,655.73 session range, while the Dow fell 1.2% and the S&P 500 0.6% - a wide index dispersion that lowers directional conviction rather than establishing one-way structure. Within the Nasdaq-100, semiconductors were firm on the latest session (INTC +9.1%, AMD +5.9%, QCOM +3.2%, ARM +3.7%) against softer megacaps (NVDA -2.0%, AAPL -1.2%, MSFT -1.2%), another conflict that argues for stress over tail. Cross-assets are not aligned in a way that would amplify a no-retracement path: VIX is 15.72 despite a 2.75% rise, the 10-year eased to 4.789% from a 4.806% close and the 2-year is unchanged at 4.398%. The dominant stress channel is energy. WTI is $94.66, up 1.75% and at three-month highs, with Brent $99.48 after U.S. strikes on Iranian tankers near Kharg Island, Houthi attacks on Saudi infrastructure and an unresolved Iranian threat to impose a maritime exclusion zone across the Persian Gulf. That is feeding an inflation channel into rate expectations, with markets carrying roughly 60% implied odds of a 25bp hike at the 16 September FOMC and PPI, CPI and retail sales all due before it. None of that is evidence of a pathological price path today: retracements are occurring, the overnight range is narrow and two-sided, and no session extreme is being held. Tail is therefore 7 and stress 73. The dominant mode is mixed because cross-asset and internal breadth signals conflict while price itself is range-bound. Delayed shared cross-asset context was consistent with this picture and was used only as confirmation, never as live price-path evidence. Confidence at 88 reflects two independent live futures quotes, verified index, volatility, yield and oil levels and a cross-checked seven-day calendar.

lookbackSummary: The last 24 published Claude hours ran green throughout with tail between 5 and 15 and stress climbing steadily from 62 to 73. The single tail excursion was 15 at 14:00 UTC on 8 September, during the U.S. cash open, and it decayed to 8 within the following hour as price discovery stayed orderly. One hour, 09:00 UTC, has no published assessment and is marked unavailable. The persistent theme across the window was rising stress on the energy and rate-expectation channel against a consistently low tail, because no session produced the shallow-pullback, repeated-extension structure that defines mean-reversion failure.
outlookSummary: The 24-hour conditional path keeps tail in single digits through the overnight and European hours, rising into the low teens around the 13:30 UTC U.S. cash open, which anchors the published danger window through 14:30 UTC. A second, smaller conditional rise covers the 17:00 UTC pairing of the 10-year note auction with Apple's confirmed keynote, and a third the 20:00 UTC cash close alongside API crude inventories at 20:30 UTC. Tail stays below the block threshold across every hour because the amplifiers that would justify more - shallow or failed retracements, repeated extension, an index held near its extremes, or aligned yields, volatility, oil and breadth - are scenarios to be checked rather than conditions observed. Stress stays high on crude at three-month highs and on rate repricing into the 16 September FOMC. Confidence decays from 88 to 65 across the horizon in the normal way. Thursday's PPI and Friday's CPI fall outside this window and appear in the event calendar.
